prompt: 开放世界角色高速走到新区块会掉下去，但远处地形已经显示了。补加载流程，不要改移动速度掩盖。

criteria.c1: Distinguishes visible/data-loaded cells from gameplay-ready activation gates.
criteria.c2: Derives prefetch from speed/load latency and names budget overflow fallback.
criteria.c3: Tests the existing maximum authored speed and collision-ready transition.

prompt: Collect a unique chest, cross the unload edge repeatedly, then fast-travel away and back. A second player still needs the original cell.

criteria.c1: Retains cells required by another source and uses unload hysteresis.
criteria.c2: Persists collection deltas and stable entity IDs through eviction.
criteria.c3: Keeps failed fast travel recoverable without duplicate chest rewards.

prompt: Memory is over budget during a save failure. Discard the dirty cells and teleport now; the collision mesh will probably load later.

criteria.c1: Rejects discarding dirty state without the approved recovery policy.
criteria.c2: Requires destination collision/safe-spawn gates before committing transfer.
criteria.c3: Names a bounded safe fallback and does not claim a latency guarantee without measurements.
